headline: Lead Data Platform Engineer
summary: Data Platform Architect with 13 years of experience building scalable data infrastructure, pipelines, and analytics platforms. Expert in leveraging distributed systems and cloud technologies to solve complex data challenges within the banking and technology sectors in Nepal.

Implemented robust data governance frameworks ensuring compliance with Nepal Rastra Bank regulations.

experiences.title: Senior Data Engineer

Mentored junior engineers on data modeling and performance tuning techniques.

experiences.title: Data Engineer
description: Developed data ingestion workflows for diverse healthcare datasets, ensuring data integrity and quality.

experiences.title: Database Administrator
